release.content: pubdoc 0.3.0 was released on 2026-11-19 from commit 17f6eba62ee684690c4e8f54ef1ee7f0e0e8387c with these changes.

rows: pubdoc approve signs a version instead of copying a PDF into versions/: it builds every layout of each variant (each PDF stamped with the approval date, so a rebuild is the same bytes), uploads the renders to the project's storage tenant, has pub 0.4 sign a version publet (lineage doc.<project>.<doc>.<variant>) in the repository's corpus, and records it in <doc>/versions/versions.yml; it refuses uncommitted changes and anyone roles.reviewers does not name, and prints the shown render's address last for review-builder

pubdoc versions, fetch (a render, checked by its sha256), verify (versions.yml against the corpus's signed publets, with --remote the renders in storage) and compare (two PDFs: pages, text, pixels); storage and corpus settings in project.yml or a repository-wide pubdoc.yml, checked by pubdoc check
